verdicts.reason: Both are effectively the same broken layout. The line frame is left as an empty box, and all the text has been dumped below it. The reading order is scrambled: 'Tickets available' now sits above 'Richmond High School Theatre Presents', and the credits line is as big as the presenter line. The orange tint stops short of the top, leaving an untinted photo strip, and an oversized play-arrow sits in a dead black band at the bottom. B's arrow is shifted a few pixels to the right, which makes no real difference.
